[Probabilistic Colocalization Estimator](https://github.com/mansonmyr/Probabilistic_Colocalization_Estimator) is a predecessor and migration source; its original terms are retained in `Probabilistic_Colocalization_Estimator.LICENSE`.

The new application license is undecided. These notices do not relicense predecessor code or third-party dependencies. Dependency and model license inventories must be completed before distribution. No N2V or LLM weights have been copied into this repository.
